titulo: Poder in the preterite vs the imperfect
subtitulo: Pudo abrir la puerta / No podía abrir la puerta.
regla: Pude = managed to, succeeded (we know the result). No pude = failed to. Podía / no podía = could / couldn't, the ability at that time, without saying how it turned out. Always + infinitive.

bloques.texto: Tip: **pudo** reports the outcome; **podía** describes the situation.

filas.t: Ella podía ayudar a su amiga.
Ella pudo ayudar a su amiga.

lista.nota: _She was in a position to help_ vs _she managed to help_.

filas.t: Javier no podía abrir la puerta.
Javier no pudo abrir la puerta.

lista.nota: **No podía**: he was struggling, we don't know how it ended. **No pudo**: he failed.

lista.es: ==No pude== hablar con ella ayer porque no había señal.
lista.en: I couldn't talk to her yesterday because there was no signal.

lista.es: Los ingenieros ==no pudieron== arreglar el problema.
lista.en: The engineers didn't manage to fix the problem.

lista.es: Ángela ==pudo== conseguir lugar en el taller de dibujo.
lista.en: Ángela managed to get a spot in the drawing workshop.

lista.es: Ustedes ==no pudieron== llegar a tiempo a la estación.
lista.en: You didn't make it to the station on time.

lista.es: Carlos ==no podía== hablar con ella porque estaba nervioso.
lista.en: Carlos couldn't talk to her because he was nervous.

lista.es: Anoche Gabriel ==no podía== meter la llave en la cerradura.
lista.en: Last night Gabriel couldn't get the key into the lock.

lista.es: Desde la ventana ==podían== espiar al vecino.
lista.en: From the window they could spy on the neighbor.

filas.t: Por fin podía terminar el maratón.
Por fin pude terminar el maratón.

lista.texto: [[5052|poder in the present perfect and preterite]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _We finally managed to sleep._
In Spanish: _I couldn't see well because it was dark._
lista.r: No podía ver bien porque estaba oscuro.

lista.p: In Spanish: _They didn't manage to find the house._
